fields.name: symbols
fields.label: Symbols
fields.hint: Up to 12, separated by commas, as Yahoo Finance writes them: AAPL or MSFT for a US stock, a market's suffix for others (ASML.AS Amsterdam, SAP.DE Xetra, VOD.L London, 7203.T Tokyo, SHOP.TO Toronto), ^GSPC for the S&P 500 (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^FTSE, ^GDAXI, ^N225), BTC-USD for crypto, EURUSD=X for a currency pair, GC=F for gold futures. Look a symbol up on finance.yahoo.com. With Twelve Data: AAPL, EUR/USD, BTC/USD. Give one its own name after a bar: "GC=F | Gold". One symbol alone shows as a big chart.

fields.name: range
fields.label: Chart
fields.hint: How far back each chart goes. A dotted line marks where it started (for Today, the previous close).

fields.name: source
fields.label: Quotes from
fields.hint: Yahoo Finance needs no account or key: the frame asks Yahoo's public chart data, the same the finance.yahoo.com pages use, about 2 KB a symbol. US stocks are live during the session (Nasdaq's last sale), most other exchanges 15 to 20 minutes late; crypto trades around the clock. It is an unofficial service, for personal use under Yahoo's terms, and it may change or limit how often a frame asks. Twelve Data is an official API with a free plan (800 requests a day, 8 a minute: one per symbol at each update, two when a chart is fetched again): make a key on twelvedata.com.

fields.name: twelveDataKey
fields.label: Twelve Data API key
fields.hint: Sign up on twelvedata.com (the free Basic plan will do) and copy the key from your dashboard. It is kept in this scene's settings on the frame, like a password.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

stocks.name: Stocks
stocks.description: A watchlist of stocks, indexes, crypto and currencies: price, change since the previous close and a chart, from Yahoo Finance (no key) or Twelve Data. One symbol is a big chart.
